senses.sense_definition: The branch of medicine and biology that studies the immune system and its responses to pathogens.

examples.text: She decided to specialize in <w>immunology</w> to better understand how vaccines protect the human body.

target_lang_translations.zh: 她决定专攻<w>免疫学</w>，以更好地了解疫苗如何保护人体。

examples.text: Recent breakthroughs in <w>immunology</w> have led to new treatments for various autoimmune diseases.

target_lang_translations.zh: <w>免疫学</w>领域的最新突破为多种自身免疫性疾病带来了新的治疗方法。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 研究免疫系统及其对病原体反应的医学和生物学分支。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 研究生物体免疫系统结构与功能的科学。
